title: Close-area moving obstacles: walking people in the arena, A* replan vs A* + PX4-CBF range filter vs APF
summary: Moving-obstacle family for the shared close-area-arena. moving.py draws 1-3 person-sized cylinders (r 0.25 m) per layout on seeded segments across the A-B corridor and walks them at constant speed, ping-pong; MovingWorld wraps the arena World so the range fans and the truth collision check see the current positions while the prior OccGrid holds static obstacles only. astar_replan.py subclasses the arena's A* + ESDF planner to plan on the prior map plus the latest scan hits, rebuilt every replan (2.5 Hz periodic, early replan up to 5 Hz). run_moving.py flies 50 random layouts at mover speeds 0.0 (frozen control), 0.5 and 1.0 m/s with four arms: A* replan, A* at 5 Hz, A* + F2 (PX4-CBF as shipped, from close-area-safety-filter) and APF (from close-area-planner-reactive), scores on truth, and reports reached, collision, stuck, min clearance, time to collision, warning time from first sighting and the vehicle's closing speed at contact. No motion prediction. numpy + scipy only.
verified: ran 2026-11-09 with CPython 3.12.10 + numpy 2.5.4 / scipy 1.18.1 on an Apple M3 Max (macOS arm64), in the sample venv (uv venv --python 3.12): run_moving.py --layouts 50 --seed 0 --workers 14 ran 600 runs in 21.4 s and wrote results/moving_0.json/.md and results/run_stdout.txt; analyze.py wrote results/analysis_0.md from it; a single-process rerun of every 23rd run (27 runs) gave identical scores (results/rerun_check.txt). The harness reproduces close-area-safety-filter's F2 truth-pose stuck layouts with no movers (layout 2 min clearance 0.8981 m in both). Every number in README is from results/. test_smoke.py: 1 passed in the venv, 1 skipped under plain python3 without numpy. No sibling sample file was edited. Layouts, people, vehicle and range fan are simulated, pose is truth; no SITL, no real drone, no motion prediction, one seed and one static family.
shows: What walking people (1-3 per layout, 0.5 and 1.0 m/s) do to A* replanning, A* + PX4-CBF range filter and APF in the arena: collisions, stuck, clearance, time and warning before contact
key_result: [50 random layouts, seed 0](README.md#results-ran-2026-11-09-apple-m3-max-cpython-31210-numpy-254-scipy-1181): A* replanning on prior map + latest scan collides in 14 % (0.5 m/s people) and 36 % (1.0 m/s) vs 0 % with the people frozen, 5 Hz replanning gives 12 % / 36 %; adding F2 (PX4-CBF) gives 0 % collisions at both speeds but 16 % stuck (F2's static deadlock layouts); APF 0 % / 2 % collision, 98 % / 94 % reached
